summary: The terminal plugin is chosen from ansible_network_os and shouldn't need overriding. Terminal plugins have no configuration. All terminal options are exposed in the network_cli connection plugin.
questions: How do I configure terminal settings for network devices?
Can I override the terminal plugin Ansible picks?

answer_card.title: Configuring terminal behavior
answer_card.answer_md: The terminal plugin comes from `ansible_network_os` and needs no configuration. Set terminal options on the `network_cli` connection plugin instead.
